blurb: Guests sail on a 40-foot Santa Cruz monohull sailboat named Blue, designed for speed and adventure but transformed for comfortable, memorable days on Lake Tahoe. The boat offers space to stretch out, room to gather, and a relaxed atmosphere for slow mornings, golden afternoons, and sunset cruises. The experience includes sailing with good people and good vibes, enjoying the sun, mountains, and wind in the sails.
